subject.title: Feature Request: Add 'description' field to agent config for dynamic agent discovery

question: Should authorized `agents_list` callers receive trimmed nonblank `agents.list[].description` values, or should that operator-authored metadata remain config-only or be gated?
rationale: The implementation is small, but it changes which free-form config metadata becomes visible to agent tool output, and repository policy treats model-visible metadata and config-surface changes as maintainer-owned boundaries.

options.title: Accept Narrow Output
options.body: Expose only trimmed nonblank descriptions for agents already visible through `agents_list`, then refresh and review the linked pull request for merge.

options.title: Gate Or Narrow Output
options.body: Require an explicit visibility setting or narrower caller boundary before returning configured descriptions.

options.title: Reject Core Exposure
options.body: Keep descriptions as config-only metadata and close or supersede the linked pull request in favor of a broader roster or prompt design.

recommendation.title: Accept Narrow Output
recommendation.body: Expose only trimmed nonblank descriptions for agents already visible through `agents_list`, then refresh and review the linked pull request for merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This account introduced `agents_list` and has the strongest feature-history signal for the multi-agent discovery boundary.
